title: Product pages down
summary: Product pages time out, while the rest of the site works fine.
alert: [FIRING] ClientsGivingUp: clients give up on more than 1% of API requests before getting an answer (currently ~47 %)

questions.prompt: What are product pages waiting for?

choices.label: A connection from the database pool

questions.prompt: Recommendations computes most answers in under 40 ms. Why do they all take seconds?

choices.label: A few slow requests keep all its workers busy, and every other request queues behind them
Product pages send it more requests than it can handle
The network between the API and Recommendations is slow
The new model is slower for every product
The API runs out of connections to Recommendations

questions.prompt: Why does a problem with recommendations take product pages down?

choices.label: The page waits up to 30 s for them, and fails without them
The API retries failed calls and multiplies the load
The API has too few connections to Recommendations
